sources.title: [2607.13639v1] OvisOCR2 Technical Report - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: We introduce OvisOCR2, a 0.8B document parsing model. OvisOCR2 is designed as an end-to-end parser: given a document page image, it generates a Markdown representation in natural reading order, covering text, formulas, tables, and visual regions.
